test_join_outer_indexer: test the PeriodIndex._outer_indexer method returns correct indexer arrays for a daily period range
test_join_types: test the PeriodIndex.join method with different join types on overlapping period ranges
test_join_self_identity: test that PeriodIndex.join with itself returns the same index object for any join type
test_join_cross_index_types: test joining a DatetimeIndex with a PeriodIndex returns a generic Index with object dtype
test_join_mismatched_freq: test that PeriodIndex.join with mismatched frequencies falls back to object dtype join
